name: Alex Morgan
headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
tagline: Building resilient web applications and distributed cloud services at scale.
bio: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling resilient web applications and distributed cloud services. Proficient in Python, TypeScript, React, and cloud architecture with a passion for developer tooling, clean code, and user-centric software design.

projects.title: DevFlow - AI Developer Workflow Assistant
projects.tagline: AI-powered CLI and web interface automating repetitive development tasks.
projects.description: Built a command-line tool and web interface that analyzes codebases and automates repetitive development tasks using generative AI models.

projects.title: TaskPulse - Real-time Collaborative Task Manager
projects.tagline: Real-time Kanban board with collaborative editing and role-based permissions.
projects.description: Created a real-time collaborative Kanban board featuring drag-and-drop mechanics, instant updates via WebSockets, and secure role-based access control.

projects.title: CloudMetrics - Lightweight Infrastructure Monitoring Dashboard
projects.tagline: Lightweight resource monitoring tool providing interactive visual charts of server metrics.
projects.description: Engineered a lightweight resource monitoring tool providing interactive visual charts of server CPU, memory, and network throughput using Prometheus and Docker.

experience.description: Architected and deployed high-throughput microservices and led frontend performance optimization initiatives.
highlights: Architected and deployed microservices handling over 50 million daily API requests with 99.99% uptime.
Led the frontend redesign of the core analytics dashboard using React and TypeScript, decreasing page load times by 42%.
Mentored a team of 6 junior and mid-level engineers, establishing coding standards and automated code review workflows.
Implemented real-time telemetry streaming using WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub, reducing data lag from 15 seconds to under 300 milliseconds.

experience.description: Developed scalable APIs and reusable component libraries for high-throughput enterprise clients.
highlights: Developed scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using Python (FastAPI) and PostgreSQL for high-throughput enterprise clients.
Built reusable modular component libraries in React that accelerated team feature delivery by 35%.
Integrated automated end-to-end testing pipelines with GitHub Actions, catching 25% more regression bugs before production deployment.
Collaborated with product managers and UX designers to iterate rapidly on user feedback cycles.
